result.reason: The redline does not reach the preferred position because it permits Licensor to assign without consent to Affiliates and transaction successors, whereas the playbook requires Customer consent for every Vendor assignment and an absolute competitor prohibition. It also does not reach the fallback: consent-free successor assignments require written notice, but no notice obligation applies generally to Licensor assignments, and the Affiliate carve-out exceeds the fallback. The change-of-control revisions appropriately remove Licensor's consent and termination rights, but the assignment changes grant Licensor broader rights than necessary. Drafting is generally understandable but contains duplication and a missing period before “Subject to the terms of this Section.”
